name: Deborah Topping

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Second wife of Rev. Abner Reeve; called 'Deborah Topping, or Tapping, of Brookhaven'.

bioAdditions: Mother of Tapping Reeve, born at Fire Place, Brookhaven, in 1744 (S1). Her parentage remains unknown; Howell's Topping genealogy does not include a Brookhaven Deborah.
openQuestionsNew: Who were Deborah Topping's parents? A Brookhaven Topping family c.1717 is not in Howell (Southampton). Check Brookhaven town records and Charles E. Topping's Topping Genealogy (1980).

sources.citation: F. B. Dexter, Biographical Sketches of the Graduates of Yale College, vol. 1 (1885) (archive.org full text), p. 434
sources.supports: Abner Reeve m. Dec 1743 Deborah Topping or Tapping of Brookhaven; she d. 1759; son Tapping b. 1744

searchedNoResult: Howell 1887 Topping genealogy pp. 395-396 (no Deborah of Brookhaven)
researchLogEntry: Round 4: marriage Dec 1743 and death 1759 from Dexter; parentage still unknown.
